premises.text: African logistics lack flexibility and centralized coordination, so contracted trucks often fail to show and goods cost far more
premises.evidence_span: there's no flexibility or centralized coordination in the system

premises.text: Truckers sit empty or idle most of the time and wait days to load/offload for short journeys
premises.evidence_span: The truckers are empty or idle 93% of the time

premises.text: Tech-enabled logistics optimization provides flexibility and centralized coordination across the journey
premises.evidence_span: We are a tech-enabled logistics optimization solution that provides this flexibility and centralized coordination

premises.text: Thousands of truck/journey data points enable data-driven redirects when delays or port issues occur
premises.evidence_span: collecting thousands of data points of every single truck in every journey and then providing data-driven decision making

premises.text: Operations dashboards give cargo owners and transporters visibility and peace of mind on loading, transit, and offload
premises.evidence_span: providing these details and information to our customers, our cargo owners and our transporters, and allowing them to have peace of mind

premises.text: Google Waze partnership and live tracking/push notifications improve coordination and visibility
premises.evidence_span: partnered with Google Waze in order to better optimize our tracking coordination platform

premises.text: Focus on large-volume haulage of grains, fertilizers, cement, and sugar across Sub-Saharan Africa, starting in Kenya and Uganda
premises.evidence_span: Right now we're focused on grains, fertilizers, cement, and sugar

value.text: Bring down the cost of goods by revolutionizing continental logistics
value.evidence_span: bringing down the cost of goods for all of us and for the whole continent

secondary_value.text: Peace of mind for cargo owners and transporters during stressful moves
secondary_value.evidence_span: allowing them to have peace of mind, which we found to be quite important in these stressful times

causal_links.evidence_span: Lorry is moving large volumes across Sub-Saharan Africa

notes: Shipper and trucker pain folded as one coordination-failure problem set with two facets kept because separately failable (P1 vs P2). Run-rate/retention traction excluded. Waze noted as beta but still a claimed coordination condition.
